meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 剪辑出品牌片、蒙太奇、片头等各类自定义视频作品。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要灵活创作非模板化的自定义视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Produce and edit custom video pieces, from brand reels to montages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a flexible video creation tool for original, non-templated content.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 接到视频任务时,会按 HyperFrames 的固定流程走:先检查并更新技能,处理媒体或 Figma 输入,读取项目/BRIEF 状态,再决定全自动执行或与你协作;产出多场景长片、宣传片、蒙太奇等视频合成物。
howto.when: 当没有专用视频工作流匹配,或 BRIEF.md 把 flow 设为 companion 时触发;典型用于较长/多场景片段、品牌宣传片、蒙太奇等任务;全新创作须先经 hyperframes 路由,只有返回 workflow: general-video 或 flow: companion 时才进入本技能。

say.text: 用 HyperFrames 按这份 BRIEF 做一支多场景宣传片。
say.note: 会先读 BRIEF、规划调度,再进入制作。

say.text: 把这几段素材剪成品牌蒙太奇,并加上转场和统一调色。
say.note: 会做时间剪切、转场生成并应用媒体调色。

say.text: 我想以协作模式打磨这条片,先以导演视角给一份完整方案。
say.note: 会先给出完整方案,并经你确认后推进。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude applies HyperFrames video steps: refresh/check the skill, adapt media or Figma input, read project/BRIEF state, then execute automatically or collaboratively, producing long-form videos, promos, montages, and more.
howto.when_en: Used when no specialized video workflow fits or BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Covers long/multi-scene videos, promos, montages. Fresh work must route via hyperframes before use.

say_en.text: Make a multi-scene promo from this brief using HyperFrames.
say_en.note: It will read the brief, plan, and start production.

say_en.text: Cut these clips into a brand montage, adding transitions and unified color.
say_en.note: It will time the cuts, add transitions, and apply media grading.

say_en.text: Let's co-create this piece; first give me a full director-level plan.
say_en.note: It will present a full plan and wait for your approval before building.
